name: WasteMates Enquiry Agent
description: Submits a rubbish-removal or waste-collection quote enquiry to WasteMates, a Melbourne-based rubbish removal business, on a visitor's behalf. Backed by the same delivery pipeline (email, Telegram, Discord) as the on-site enquiry form.

skills.name: Submit Rubbish Removal Enquiry
skills.description: Submits a quote/enquiry for rubbish removal, waste collection, or a related service (e.g. green waste, construction waste, deceased estates, garage/shed cleanouts). Requires at least one contact method — name, mobile, or email. Every call resolves synchronously to a terminal or input-required Task in the same response; there is no polling, streaming, or push-notification support. Photo attachments are not supported over this interface — direct the enquirer to https://wastemates.com.au/contact.html to attach photos.
examples: {"name": "Jordan Smith", "mobile": "0412345678", "suburb": "Croydon", "job": "Household rubbish removal", "details": "Old couch and mattress in the garage"}
Get a quote for a garage cleanout in Ringwood East for someone named Alex, email alex@example.com
